title: 치과에서: 어디가, 언제부터 아파요?
objective: Tell a dentist which tooth hurts and use -다가 to say what you were doing.
summary: A patient tells the dentist which tooth hurts and when the pain started.
setting: A dental clinic in Korea: the patient talks to the dentist in the dentist's chair.

task.title: Talk about tooth pain
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to choose, fill in, order, or write your answers in Korean.

words.exampleMeaning: Don't chew hard food with your back teeth.

words.example: 단 걸 많이 먹어서 충치가 생겼어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I got a cavity because I ate a lot of sweets.

words.meaning: to be sensitive (sharp pain from cold)
words.example: 요즘 이가 시려서 아이스크림을 못 먹어요.
words.exampleMeaning: My teeth are sensitive these days, so I can't eat ice cream.
Please say "ah" and open your mouth.
I ate an apple and my gums bled.
My teeth got clean after the cleaning.

dialogue.korean: 이가 아파서 왔어요. 어제 저녁을 먹다가 갑자기 아팠어요.
dialogue.meaning: I came because my tooth hurts. It suddenly started hurting while I was eating dinner yesterday.

dialogue.korean: 왼쪽 아래 어금니요. 찬물을 마시면 많이 시려요.
dialogue.meaning: My lower back tooth on the left. It's very sensitive when I drink cold water.
You have a cavity. Do your gums bleed too?

dialogue.korean: 네, 이를 닦다가 가끔 피가 나요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, they sometimes bleed when I brush my teeth.

dialogue.korean: 오늘 충치를 치료하고, 스케일링도 받으세요. 아프시면 왼손을 드세요.
dialogue.meaning: We'll treat the cavity today, and please get a cleaning too. If it hurts, raise your left hand.

exercises: Change the verb in brackets into the -다가 form: ① 사탕을 (씹다) ____ 이가 깨졌어요. ② 찬물을 (마시다) ____ 이가 갑자기 시렸어요.
Choose the right word: ① 찬 걸 먹으면 이가 (시려요 / 벌려요). ② 단 걸 많이 먹으면 (충치가 / 잇몸이) 생겨요.
Read the dialogue again. Write O if the sentence is true and X if it is false: ① 환자는 오른쪽 어금니가 아파요. ② 환자는 이를 닦다가 가끔 피가 나요. ③ 치료할 때 아프면 오른손을 들어요.
Your tooth started to hurt while you were drinking coffee. Tell the dentist in Korean, using -다가.
Answer the dentist in Korean. Your upper back tooth on the right hurts: 의사: 어느 쪽 이가 아프세요? 나: ____
answers: ① X ② O ③ X
커피를 마시다가 이가 아팠어요. (커피를 마시다가 갑자기 이가 아팠어요.)
오른쪽 위 어금니요. (오른쪽 위 어금니가 아파요.)
